# Spec: https://llmstxt.org

# Site Overview
> Capitalize Titaly (https://capitalizetitaly.com) is a free, browser-based
> collection of writing and text tools. It converts titles to APA, Chicago, AP,
> MLA, Bluebook, AMA, NYT and Wikipedia style title case. It also offers text
> converters, AI-powered title generators, word game solvers, text generators,
> name generators and a writing blog.

## About
- Founded: 2015
- Owner / Publisher: Capitalize Titaly
- Contact: https://capitalizetitaly.com/contact
- Privacy Policy: https://capitalizetitaly.com/privacy-policy
- Terms of Service: https://capitalizetitaly.com/terms

## Core Tool — Title Case Converter
- URL: https://capitalizetitaly.com
- Description: Paste any title and convert it to the correct capitalization
  style for APA, Chicago, AP, MLA, Bluebook, AMA, NYT or Wikipedia.
  Supports sentence case, all caps and lowercase modes too.

## Converter Tools
- Comma Separator: https://capitalizetitaly.com/tools/comma-separator
  Turn a column of items into a comma-separated list for SQL, CSV or tags.
- CSV to JSON: https://capitalizetitaly.com/tools/csv-to-json
  Convert CSV/TSV data to clean JSON. Runs entirely in the browser.
- JSON to CSV: https://capitalizetitaly.com/tools/json-to-csv
  Flatten a JSON array into a CSV file you can open in Excel or Sheets.
- Uppercase to Lowercase: https://capitalizetitaly.com/tools/uppercase-to-lowercase
  Convert text between uppercase, lowercase, title case and sentence case.
- Square Image Maker: https://capitalizetitaly.com/tools/square-image
  Pad or crop any image into a square for social media without distortion.
